what: Emberpup, a small baby fire lizard, alone and abandoned: a small young lizard that sits upright on its haunches like a person sitting, painted seriously as a real little creature with a soft, plump little body, a big round head with a smooth domed skull, full round cheeks and a short, blunt, rounded snout with small nostrils at its tip, a closed mouth turned down at the corners, large round dark eyes looking down, the lids drooping half shut, heavy and tired, a short neck, short arms with three small claws, short stout hind legs with three-toed feet, and a long thick tail. Its skin is smooth and soft, with only very fine faint scales, warm orange, the orange of a ripe apricot, darkened and glistening where the rain has soaked it; its belly and the front of its throat are pale cream. At the very tip of its tail burns one small flame of yellow and orange fire, no bigger than its own hand, shrunk low and guttering in the rain, with a thin wisp of grey steam rising from it. It is cold, soaked, lonely and sad.
colours: smooth warm apricot-orange skin darkened by rain, a pale cream belly and throat, large dark brown eyes, small pale claws, a small guttering yellow and orange flame at the tail tip, a thin wisp of grey steam, a rock of dark warm grey stone with brown in it, a small dark charcoal-grey rain cloud, streaks of rain in bright silver-white.

pose: Seen from the front and a little from the side, facing left: it sits upright on top of the rock on its haunches, both hind feet flat on the stone in front of it, its short arms hanging limp in its lap; its shoulders are hunched against the rain and its head hangs down, chin almost on its chest, eyes half shut, looking down at its feet; its long tail curls round beside it on the rock so the little guttering flame at the tip sits on the stone next to its feet, where it can be seen clearly. Exactly two arms and two legs.
scene_whole: shown whole and small in the middle of the picture: the rain cloud above, the little lizard in the middle, the rock below. The little lizard is the biggest thing in the picture. scene_props: The little lizard sits on one single low flat-topped rock of dark warm grey stone with brown in it, wet and shining, a little wider than the lizard sitting with its tail curled round, and no taller than the lizard's legs; the rock stands by itself on nothing, with no ground, no grass and no puddle round it.
